Team CollectorsPROBLEM · SOLUTION · PROTOTYPE

CVIAF — Computer Vision Integrity Assurance Framework

Problem & insight

  • Datasets, models and inference logs arrive from parties we do not control — each can be poisoned, swapped or edited.
  • Today's checks cover one link each, none covers the chain, and none works when the network is gone.
  • Classifier-era defences do not transfer: phantom boxes and cloaked objects have no classifier analogue.

Our solution

  • One offline engine assesses data, model, inference records and drift, then merges every flag into one signed report.
  • Ground truth first: a laboratory plants known attacks, so every detector is scored, not asserted.
  • Every score is a conformal p-value against a signed reference battery we control; sample flags roll up per contributor.

Innovation & proof

  • Calibrated, not tuned — an explicit error guarantee, and accept is forbidden when an applicable check did not run.
  • Cryptographic binding of image, model digest, config and output makes tamper, substitution and replay detectable.
  • Imaged AUROC 0.9866 (fused_bonf, OGA fabrication) / 0.9062 (ODA cloaking); clean controls 0.500.
  • Provenance: CVIAF 8/8 attacked records vs 4/8 for the enrolled-digest baseline; 0/2 genuine false alarms.
  • One end-to-end report: 17 findings, CRITICAL → quarantine, 27.1 s audit-trail span (run oda_s5).

AUROC is an image-level ranking statistic on 8 laboratory models, not model-level recall. Provenance run signed with HMAC-SHA256 fallback, not Ed25519.

Architecture — users and actors over the offline chain. Everything inside the dashed trust boundary is computed from assets the team controls; contributors sit outside it.
Working measurement dashboard — committed clean-null ledger: 28,313 held-out negatives, alpha 0.05. Captured at committed settings; peak/q95 thresholds shown as degenerate.

Team CollectorsTECHNICAL APPROACH & FINDINGS

TECHNICAL APPROACH

Every artefact entering a computer-vision pipeline — data, model, inference record — is measured against a reference we own. Detection is scored only at thresholds the clean ledger froze first: RefDiv-mean catches 47.9% (45/94) of substitution attacks at dose 0.25 and 93.7% (59/63) at dose 0.50, and 92.9% (92/99) of weight tamper at dose 1.00 — while CTC-mean, equally calibrated, catches almost none.
intake • referencesignalsfrozen calibrationattack scoringfindings • coverage
FindingEvidenceLimit
Worked: RefDiv sensitivity rises with measured damagesubstitution 13/99 → 45/94 → 59/63; weight_tamper 7/99 → 92/99. CTC-mean catches 2–29% at the same threshold.thresholds frozen from the clean ledger; arms are synthetic TinyDetector models
Did not work: bias lift stays at the false-alarm rate5/99 = 5.1% at every dose; 396/396 arms behaviour-inert (zero F1 change)inert weight change, not a proven harmful backdoor — the blind spot is declared
Failure handled: unscorable arms are reported, not hidden1,188 built → 1,055 scored; 133 unscorable, all substitutionsubstitution 1.00 dose has n=7, below min_positives=20 — shown hollow, never as 100%

Frozen thresholds, two populations kept apart — clean-null ledger: 28,313 held-out negatives; refdiv_mean_clean 5.18%, ctc_mean_clean 5.23%, both intervals including 5%; ctc_peak/q95 degenerate at the corpus ceiling. Coverage 14 of 14 clauses measured, gate_ok=True.

Team CollectorsIMPACT & BENEFITS

IMPACT AND BENEFITS

Implemented baseline checks vs CVIAF on the same laboratory cases. This is a measured tradeoff on a small cohort, not a claim of universal superiority.
What changedBefore (implemented baseline)After (CVIAF)Boundary
Model axisfixed threshold 2/2 TPR, 4/4 FPR1/2 TPR, 0/4 FPR2 positives, 4 negatives, 2 ASR-gated excluded
Inference tamper + replayenrolled digest 4/8; abstains 2 attacked, 2 genuine8/8, FPR 0/2HMAC fallback; tamper check, not proof of origin
Data asset triage7/7 TPR but 1/1 false alarm2/7 TPR, 0/1 false alarmfewer asset false alarms, lower recall in this run
Sample-level decisionsTP 363 / FP 24, TPR 84.03%, precision 93.80%TP 73 / FP 51, TPR 16.90%, precision 58.87%unfavourable to CVIAF — retained in the supplement
Accountabilityhash-only: top-1 undefined, 0/8 detectedtop-1 2/2 on single-culprit classes2 scored classes; not universal source accuracy

Read this as an engineering result: fewer asset false alarms and a richer evidence trail, paid for with lower item-level recall. The 56,627-model clean study measures false alarms only — it cannot produce TPR, precision or savings, and no measured reduction in analyst hours, incidents, cost or readiness risk exists in this repository.

Signal names are published methods: CTC and FTC are TRACE (CVPR 2025, arXiv 2503.15293), and the OGA / RMA / GMA / ODA attack labels are BadDet. This engine reimplements those mechanisms at MVP scale — the published numbers stay with their authors and are not quoted here. Evidence manifest: evidence/evidence_manifest.json — every slide number maps to a file, field and denominator. All figures are laboratory/synthetic scope; field validation is pending. docs/PS26228_REQUIREMENT_TRACE.md is historical design intent, not as-built evidence.
